elements.element: TrueLink must maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Section 31(a) requires commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: TrueLink must maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 31(a) requires an aggregate limit of not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: TrueLink must maintain professional errors and omissions insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 31(b) requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If TrueLink processes Customer Data, TrueLink must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 31(c) unconditionally requires cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000, so the requirement applies whenever TrueLink processes Customer Data.

elements.element: TrueLink must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: Section 31(d) requires workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law.

elements.element: TrueLink must provide certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: Section 31 requires TrueLink to provide Client with certificates evidencing the coverage upon request.

elements.element: TrueLink must maintain professional errors and omissions insurance of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 31(b) requires not less than USD 2,000,000, which exceeds the fallback minimum.

elements.element: TrueLink must maintain cyber liability insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 31(c) requires not less than USD 5,000,000, which exceeds the fallback minimum.

result.reason: The operative insurance provision meets every preferred requirement and therefore also exceeds both fallback limits. It is not minimal because it adds requirements beyond the stated position, principally a one-year post-termination maintenance period for all coverages, an express own-expense obligation, and technology E&O scope. The existing force-majeure language remains operative and no contradiction is introduced.
